LanguageData.RimWatch.Notifications.Title: Notification System
LanguageData.RimWatch.Notifications.MasterToggle.Desc: Show in-game notifications for all RimWatch actions. These are small Messages that appear in the top-right corner.
LanguageData.RimWatch.NotificationLevel.Critical.Desc: Only life-threatening events: colonist dying, fires, raids
LanguageData.RimWatch.NotificationLevel.Important.Des: Critical + important actions: blueprints created, priorities changed, colonists drafted
LanguageData.RimWatch.NotificationLevel.Moderate.Desc: Important + regular actions: hauling assigned, crops planted, mining designated
LanguageData.RimWatch.NotificationLevel.Verbose.Desc: Moderate + detailed info: coordinates, quality, materials, colonist names
LanguageData.RimWatch.NotificationLevel.Debug.Desc: Everything including execution time and internal state (for developers)
LanguageData.RimWatch.Notifications.Defense.Desc: Drafting colonists, equipping weapons, combat positioning
LanguageData.RimWatch.Notifications.Social.Desc: Prisoner management, mood events, social activities
LanguageData.RimWatch.Notifications.UseEmojis.Desc: Show emoji icons for categories (🏗️, 👷, 🌾, etc.)
LanguageData.RimWatch.Notifications.ShowPawnNames.Des: Include colonist names in notifications (e.g., "for John")
LanguageData.RimWatch.Notifications.ShowMaterials.Des: Display materials and quality in building notifications
LanguageData.RimWatch.Notifications.Example.Critical: 🏥 Medical: Colonist bleeding - immediate rescue needed!
LanguageData.RimWatch.Notifications.Example.Moderate: 👷 Work: Priority changed - Construction priority 1 (Food shortage)
LanguageData.RimWatch.Notifications.Example.Verbose: 🌾 Farming: Crop planted - Rice (growing zone #2) at (85, 92) by Emma
